paragraphs: EO2 EXP is a multi-disciplinary creative studio. We work with brands, agencies, and creative co-conspirators to make good shit happen. Every project is weaved to optimally communicate the brand ethos and increase visibility through advertising, films, events, and virtual content.

With more than 20,000 projects under our belt and ongoing retainers with numerous reputed clients, EO2 has carved a niche for itself in the Marketing Industry. Now that you know the goods, check out the goods to back them up.

cards.title: NAUGHTY AMELIA JANE
cards.description: Directed by Risheeta Agrawal, an award winning short screened across 100 international film festivals. This film is a satire on the hypocrisy and blatant ignorance of society towards people and issues that are against their "social order of things", mainly the LGBT community, told through the story of two young girls who were in love.

cards.title: BAR TALK WITH RAGHAV MEATTLE
cards.description: Shot entirely in the lockdown, breaking the taboo against the LGBTQ community, this music video highlights tender moments from same sex relationships. Featuring Sushant Divgikr, one of India's top drag performers, the video got rave reviews from LGBTQ publications as well as other cultural publications.

cards.title: PERIOD PARTY 2.0
cards.description: On World Menstrual Hygiene Day, Period Party 2.0 , a 2 day online event - a collaborative initiative was hosted, in partnership with Redisthenewgreen to ensure that everyone has access to a safe and healthy period during this pandemic! We helped raise over 18 Lacs for the cause and made sure we do good, and have a party while we’re at it :)

cards.title: PARCHAYI
cards.description: 3 years since homosexuality was decriminalized in India, but has love truly broken the shackles of society? Asking this question, our music video directed by Gaurav Gupta, explores the young love of two guys, somewhere in rural India, where it is not acceptable by the society.

/events-collection/matrix.title: Matrix See and Do
paragraphs: The Matrix See and Do event is an immersive and innovative gathering that brings together hairstylists, salon professionals, and beauty enthusiasts from all over the world. Organized by Eo2, this event aims to showcase the latest trends, techniques, and products in the hairstyling industry. Through live demonstrations, hands-on workshops, and interactive sessions, attendees have the opportunity to learn from some of the industry's leading experts and gain valuable insights into cutting-edge styling and coloring techniques.

/events-collection/youtube-fanfest.title: YouTube Fanfest
paragraphs: EO2 EXP was roped in for show direction and backstage management of the Indian edition of the popular international event, YouTube Fanfest 2 years in a row. The team at EO2 made their way to 4 different cities over 4 weekends. Over 40 YouTubers showcased their talent and the event met a grand close at Mumbai’s Jio Gardens that witnessed a footfall of almost 15,000 people!

brand.name: EO2 EXP
brand.description: EO2 EXP is a creative studio that helps brands and agencies with advertising, films, events, and virtual content.

founders.name: Vandana Agrawal
founders.description: EO2 EXP is the brainchild of founder and ship leader, Vandana Agrawal, who recognised the need for model coordination and fashion show organisers in the market back in 1993! Being a motivated and determined entrepreneur, she took the company from strength to strength over the next few years. With creating fashion shows across the country and internationally, EO2 EXP worked with the top designers in the country, including the likes of Manish Malhotra and Rajesh Singh. What started as a fashion show-based successful business then transformed into an events-based business that is now the bandwidth and power of an in-house strength of 35+ personnel and an alliance strength of 300+ personnel across events, experiential design and film.

founders.name: Risheeta Agrawal
founders.description: Rishabh and Risheeta, the next generation, always showed a keen interest in the business from a very young age. Rishabh designed his first set at the age of 8 for a fashion show celebrating 50 years of Independence in 1997. While Risheeta was pitching event decks since she was 14. This interest in the business and industry shaped their respective career paths. Rishabh went on to study further in Italy and Risheeta found her calling in films. She pursued further education at Prague Film School, which ultimately led to the birth of EO2 EXP Films. Since then, our company has built a strong reputation for reliability and quality work, cultivating enduring relationships with global brands such as Pernod Ricard, L'Oreal, ASUS, Netflix, and Amazon Prime. Our extensive clientele, including prominent names in the industry, attests to our credibility and showcases our ability to consistently deliver exceptional results.
